item.title: Cool things about XOR
item.description: What is XOR ? Xor is Exclusive OR. It’s a logical operator, which returns true when both inputs are different. In programming it is usually indicated by ^. In mathematics it’s ⊕ or ⊻. Quick look at the truth tables should explain it. a b a ^ b 1 0 1 0 0 0 1 1 1 0 1 1 But how does it work with strings or numbers like 67?

item.title: Over the wire - Natas11
item.description: I suggest reading my other post about XOR before going into this post. You will need to understand “XOR encryption” for this natas. Usual start: URL=http://natas11.natas.labs.overthewire.org curl --user natas11:$(cat natas11 ) $URL curl --user natas11:$(cat natas11 ) $URL"/index-source.html" In this issue I found a process of loading a cookie. It does 3 things: json_encode an array xor_encrypt the json base64 the json and load it as the cookie What needs to be done?
